source: User corrected and confirmed which CAD surface is the palm.
palmLandmark: The face exposing the two small finger motors, confirmed by the user.
cadCheck: Native +Z exposes both finger motor cases after diagnostic removal of outer covers (source bodies 174 and 175). positionFormat: Signed integer encoder positions; Arm_Utils.py configures extended-position mode (4), so values are not restricted to 0..4095.
visibilityNote: The landmark identifies the palm-facing side of the internal assembly; the motors are covered in normal rendered view.
